real_defects.issue: A negative remaining (or original) duration was scheduled as negative work: -80 h on driving activity A1110 of the example finished it two weeks before its start and pulled the project finish in 17 days, with no warning (a non-numeric value already warned and read as 0). Fixed: durations below 0 read as 0 with a once-per-field warning naming each activity; negative lags (leads) unchanged. Test: engine.test.mjs 'a negative duration is taken as 0 and reported'.
